Quest_TornPage.Description:
If you are reading this, you sat with the old goblin by the river and listened, and you set the four stones the way I did. I hoped it would be you. I could not know.
I came here to learn how a door between worlds is made, from the only people who ever came through one. They do not know. They were carried here, and they have spent every year since trying to build a way back. Somebody wanted four peoples at war, and when three shook hands, the fourth was made the enemy. Whose hand did it, I cannot say.
Somebody is looking for me, so I could write this nowhere but here. A man at the Castle knew more about such doors than anyone. They called him mad and he went to the forest. So will I.
I left so that the eyes would follow me and not you. Show this to no one. I mean it plain.

Quest_MartasLetter.Description:
I write this fast, so forgive the shaking hand. You saw the portal open today. That was no accident. Someone out there still hunts your father, and they follow me to find him. Every day I stay under this roof, their eyes drift closer to you. So I go, and the eyes go with me. Be angry at me. You earned it. Eat well. Sleep enough. Show this letter to no one. I have loved you since before your first breath. I mean it plain.
Marta

Spirit_Inklash.Description: The soul of an Inklash, black and slippery. It stains your fingers.

Mat_WraithCore.Description: A knobbly violet nugget from another world, bright all the way through.

Mat_MemorySap.Description: Crystallized sap from the old forest. Each drop holds four hundred years of memory.

Mat_Hematite.Description: Red iron ore. It stains your hands like rust.

Mat_Solite.Description: The cheapest enhancement stone. Good enough to start with.

Spirit_GrandfatherClock.Description: The Grandfather Clock's soul, still ticking.

Mat_RawMeat.Description: Cut from a fresh kill. Cook it first.

Spirit_SirBrankal.Description: The soul of Sir Brankal, heavy as the stone he was carved from. It sleeps in daylight.

Mat_MossyLog.Description: A log off a walking stump, still soft with moss.

Mat_GlowingMoss.Description: Moss that glows faintly, scraped off a Mossling.

Harvest_GoldenFruit.Description: Fruit that glows on its own. Probably magic.

Mat_Limestone.Description: Pale rock that crumbles when burned. It pulls the dirt out of molten metal.

Mat_WarbloodGem.Description: Warblood chips fused with a core into a clear red gem.

Harvest_Pike.Description: Long, sharp, and mean for a fish. Good steaks.

Harvest_Catfish.Description: A whiskered fish from muddy water. Tasty once cooked.

Mat_RustyGear.Description: An old gear, rusted but still turning.

Harvest_RareHerb.Description: A rare herb. The strong recipes call for it.

Mat_WarbloodHeart.Description: A flawless red gem made with a warblood crystal. Mad Sage infuses it into gear.

Mat_EnchantedBark.Description: Bark stripped from the old trees. It still creaks.

Spirit_Spigot.Description: The soul of a Spigot, cold and wet. Water beads on it at night.

Mat_SilverIngot.Description: Pure silver, burned free of its lead.

Mat_SilverLeadBullion.Description: Soft lead with silver still locked inside. It needs one more burn.

Mat_WarbloodChip.Description: Warblood stone melted down to a small red gem.

Smelt_Crucible.Description: A cast iron pot for the Smelter. Each one holds a single melt.

Mat_FrogLeg.Description: A meaty leg off a forest frog.

Mat_WraithChip.Description: Wraith stone melted down to a small violet gem.

Elec_Cable.Description: A length of insulated cable. It links two sockets up to 20 studs apart.

Mat_FossilizedAmber.Description: Ancient tree sap hardened over centuries. Something is caught inside.
Mat_FossilizedAmber.Function: Craft material for equipment, hatch material for the Catrex egg

Mat_AncientHeartwood.Description: The living core of the Rootweaver. Still pulsing.

Mat_SunruneCrystal.Description: A gold crystal from another world. It glows on its own.

Mat_TemperedPlate.Description: Folded steel quenched and tempered. Made for plate armor, shields and maces.

Mat_AmberLacquer.Description: Amber melted into varnish. It dries hard as a shell.

Mat_ScrapMetal.Description: A jagged sliver of old blade. Melt it down and reuse it.

Mat_TidalCrystal.Description: A blue crystal from another world. It glows on its own.

Mat_WraithCrystal.Description: A violet crystal from another world. It glows brighter after dark.

Spirit_Glasscap.Description: The soul of a Glasscap, clear and cold. Frost forms on it after sundown.

Mat_SunruneCore.Description: A knobbly gold nugget from another world, bright all the way through.

Mat_ArcaneElectrum.Description: Electrum steeped in lily essence. It glows faintly when magic is near.

Mat_SunruneHeart.Description: A flawless gold gem made with a sunrune crystal. Mad Sage infuses it into gear.

Spirit_CritterGoblin.Description: The restless soul of a Critter Goblin. It zips around in circles.

Spirit_TinTortoise.Description: The soul of a Tin Tortoise, snug under its pot. Tap it and it rings.

Mat_Quicklime.Description: Burnt limestone. Keep it dry, it bites wet skin.

Spirit_CupSnail.Description: The soul of a Cup Snail. Touch it and your fingers go numb.

T2_Mount_GreyWolf.Description: Raised soft and fed well. Walks off a crash like nothing happened.

Livestock_Sheep.Description: A sheep, good for wool. Raise her well and she gets big enough to ride.

T1_Mount_BrownHorse.Description: Slow, dusty, and smells like a barn. A good first horse.

T1_Pet_Clawsader.Description: A blue Cat Rex in a knight's colors.

T1_Pet_GrandpaRam.Description: An old ram with more opinions than teeth.

Livestock_Chicken.Description: A hen. Lays eggs, and grows if you feed her.

T2_Mount_WitchBroom.Description: A crooked broom with orange bristles, a purple wrap on the handle and a pink charm that glows.

T4_Mount_WhiteHorse.Description: Fluffy, white, and shaped like a loaf. Fastest horse in Homestead.

T1_Pet_MysticCow.Description: An evolved cow with a touch of magic.

T3_Mount_Junkcycle.Description: One wheel, bolted together from junkyard scrap. It runs.

T1_Mount_BrownWolf.Description: Chews saddles, but never bucks you off.

T4_Mount_WhiteWolf.Description: Thick fur, huge paws, full speed through anything.

T1_Pet_PunkRooster.Description: A rebellious rooster with attitude to spare.

T1_Pet_BanditChick.Description: A rare outlaw chick. Small but notorious.

Livestock_Cow.Description: A dairy cow. Feed her well and she'll grow, and keep the milk coming.

T1_Pet_WitchHen.Description: A hen that learned to hex.

T1_Pet_Meowchemist.Description: A green Cat Rex. Smells faintly of potions.

T1_Pet_BikerCow.Description: A cow built for the open road.

T3_Mount_BlackWolf.Description: Black as coal and quick on its feet. You never fall off.

T2_Mount_Rattletrap.Description: A goblin scrap bike with a sidecar bolted to its side and seats for three.

T1_Pet_LuchadorBull.Description: A rare bull, champion of the ring. Retired undefeated.

T1_Pet_Clawdiator.Description: A red Cat Rex. It struts.

T4_Mount_PlumThunder.Description: A small purple drake with big curled horns, strong enough to carry a rider into the sky.

T2_Mount_GreyHorse.Description: A grey horse that kicks up a wall of dust behind it.

T3_Mount_BlackHorse.Description: Black as coal and jumpy. Built for speed.

T1_Pet_PunkLamb.Description: A woolly rebel that refuses to follow the flock.

T1_Pet_Meownarch.Description: A rare black Cat Rex. Sits like it owns the place.

T1_Pet_Meowgician.Description: An orange Cat Rex, still practicing its spells.

T1_Pet_DramaQueen.Description: A sheep that treats every ordinary day as a personal tragedy.
